skills.name: graph-engineering
skills.description: Design, review, or refactor AI agent workflows into explicit execution graphs. Use when orchestration has meaningful branches, parallel workers, approvals, retries, or stateful handoffs, including slow or flaky agent loops; prefer a script for simple sequential work.

provenance.notes: User-supplied Graph Engineering runbook contributed under Apache-2.0; the unverified publication-attribution caveat is preserved in SKILL.md.

skills.name: grill-with-docs
skills.description: Interview the user about a plan, design, or decision in dependency-aware rounds with recommendations, while maintaining a domain glossary and qualifying architecture decision records. Use when asked to grill a plan, stress-test a design, or clarify and document a domain model in one session.

provenance.notes: Portable adaptation of Matt Pocock skills with required interview/domain-modeling guidance included locally; upstream MIT notice retained.

skills.name: wayfinder
skills.description: Plan a large, uncertain effort across multiple sessions as a map of decision tickets. Use when asked to chart a route, establish a planning frontier, resolve planning decisions, or resume a Wayfinder map. Maintain the destination, dependencies, decisions, unresolved fog, and a resume packet.

provenance.notes: Portable adaptation of Matt Pocock skills with required interview/domain-modeling guidance included locally; upstream MIT notice retained.
